records.question: Kest-7 started flashing amber quickly just after we moved its workload. What is the likely cause?

retained.text:
# Kest-7 cooling unit

Kest-7 is installed in the north service bay. Its grey shell and amber status lamp are normal identifying marks.

A fast amber pulse immediately after a load transfer means thermal rebound. Record the transfer time before changing any setting.

## Restart

rule

A Kest-7 may normally be restarted after its amber pulse slows and the casing is cool enough to touch.

Exception: if the casing remains hot or room pressure rises, isolate power first and do not restart the unit.
